description: Open a new support ticket for the signed-in account. The message body is the whole ticket. There is no subject or category field. Write it in the user's own words: what they were doing, what went wrong, and any error text they saw. A support agent replies on the ticket, which get_ticket reads and the user can also see on the Support page at app.nodecraft.com.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be sent to Nodecraft support as a new ticket and getting their approval.

message.description: The full ticket message. Include what the user was doing, what went wrong, and any error output.

name: create_ticket
title: Create Support Ticket
